variable_coverage.construction: EPS_jt/Price_(j,t−1): use annual continuing-operations earnings per share and prior-period share price. The Compustat EPS variant, price provider and exact prior-period date convention are not operationally identified by the paper; candidate current fields remain unverified.
DUM_jt=1 when Return_jt<0 and 0 otherwise. It is derived from the firm-period CRSP return; its date follows the unresolved fiscal-year versus nine-month-before-FYE 12-month return choice.

Return_jt is raw stock return computed alternatively over the fiscal year or the 12-month period beginning nine months before fiscal-year end. The paper does not select the alternative for this annual pooled fit.
DUM_jt×Return_jt uses the same firm-period return and negative-return indicator as the two source-defined regressors.

design_coverage.reason: The annual pooled Equation (1) result does not report a standard-error correction or clustering scheme.
Estimate the single pooled cross-sectional annual Equation (1) on the final annual sample (131,920 firm-years); source material does not identify the regression estimator or standard-error procedure.
Equation (1) reports an intercept and the three specified regressors, with no fixed-effect terms or fixed-effect specification reported for this pooled fit.
CRSP stock returns must be associated with Compustat annual firm-years through historical firm-security identifiers; the paper does not specify link-field screening.

Within each year eliminate the top and bottom 1 percent of EPS/Price and Return distributions separately; construct DUM from the sign of Return and DUM×Return. The return interval for the pooled annual fit remains unresolved.

Use Compustat 2001 PST, Full Coverage and Research firms with sufficient EPS and CRSP return data, then apply annual tail trimming; final annual sample is 14,383 firms and 131,920 firm-years over the stated 1951–2001 earnings availability.
No regression weights are specified for the pooled annual Equation (1) estimate.

implementation_issues.description: The paper calls the annual equation a regression and reports a pooled cross-sectional coefficient, but does not identify the estimator, standard-error method or clustering procedure. These details are required to reconstruct reported coefficient inference.

Return is defined alternatively over the fiscal year or the twelve-month interval beginning nine months before fiscal-year end, but the annual pooled Equation (1) result does not identify which return window it uses. This changes Return, DUM and their interaction, and the annual trimming screen.

The paper specifies continuing-operations EPS and Price_(j,t−1) but does not identify exact vendor fields, the price provider or its prior-period date convention; current annual Compustat and monthly CRSP candidates are not semantically confirmed.
Apply annual top/bottom 1 percent trimming separately to EPS/Price and Return, then create the negative-return indicator and interaction.

Construct effective-dated Compustat-to-CRSP links and resolve linktype/linkprim/use-flag treatment; current candidate fields are present but no source link policy or historic matched-population confirmation is available.

The paper uses S&P Compustat 2001 PST, Full Coverage and Research products and the cited CRSP file; accessible local Compustat merged annual and CRSP monthly files are current vintages, with historic coverage unconfirmed.

review_notes: The frozen baseline is the pooled annual Equation (1) fit only; quarterly time-series estimates and subsequent robustness/measurement analyses are outside this assessment.
The paper reports annual earnings availability for 1951–2001; return measurement is subject to fiscal-year versus nine-month-before-FYE window ambiguity.
